name: Function transfer constrained by structural correspondence
description: Constrain transferred function with relevant local structural correspondence while preserving model origin, ligand identity, access geometry and measured comparator chemistry.

support.proposition: Relevant local machinery, pocket, access route or architecture of the target corresponds to that of an identified, separately characterized structural comparator; the supported property is bounded by observed correspondence and structural origin.

operands.instruction: Retain exact structure/chain/construct identifiers, deposited versus predicted origin, residue/ligand identity, numbering correspondence, local geometry and conditions. Treat a fold, a modeled loop and a measured contact as their actual distinct propositions. Conserved catalytic architecture can strengthen broad chemistry; pocket/access changes can weaken a specific transfer. Lack of a search hit is limited by the actual search and does_not_discriminate unexamined structures. For another source subject use non-direct applicability. inferred_extent requires an explicit target_footprint bounded by the actual assigned original-input scope; missing target_footprint supplies no invented extent. context_allocation requires explicit context_account_scope and nonempty context_scope on both assessment and compatible account; it cannot carry target_footprint, creates no molecular measurement and is not a sequence map. Source residue numbers never become target coordinates.

Keep the comparator assay separate from structural correspondence and identify which measured property is relevant. TM0936 substrate negatives and positives constrain chemistry; retained ATP in MJ0577 establishes binding separately from hydrolysis, whose extract dependence leaves the enabling factor unresolved. A modeled contact explanation is not another assay. For another source subject use non-direct applicability. inferred_extent requires an explicit target_footprint bounded by the actual assigned original-input scope; missing target_footprint supplies no invented extent. context_allocation requires explicit context_account_scope and nonempty context_scope on both assessment and compatible account; it cannot carry target_footprint, creates no molecular measurement and is not a sequence map. Source residue numbers never become target coordinates.

qualifications: TM0936 local amidohydrolase similarity did not transfer cytosine specificity. Bc1793 loop explanations remain modeled and censored efficiencies remain bounds. Static geometry does not establish contact energy, catalytic necessity or physiological substrate.

Retain actual source_ref, source_subject_refs, condition_refs and assumption_refs. The published examples below are instruction provenance about their named subjects; they are not observations of ybhP/b0790 and were not repeated to prepare this draft.

At construction and in decision context, resolve these observation kinds through annotation_support_routes for the actual caller-bound annotation policy; an entry does not supply universal component labels, select a projector, mask another kind, change a weight, or create a target finding. An unavailable route declaration remains unavailable.

Use actual retained assessments in a compatible annotation account. Selecting this entry earns nothing. The current caller-owned applicability × relation × extent arithmetic, same-component maximum, coherent-account integration and derived discrimination remain unchanged for this review basis. A finding qualification is not an automatic numeric discount; no independence, confidence or new score dimension is implied.
support.boundary: This route supplies no calibrated model-to-function rule, no structural search or new coordinate calculation, and no claim that a matching fold entails a reaction. Structural support and chemical/resource accounting still share their current policy routes when the actual caller maps them together. Adequate local correspondence criteria remain unresolved.

evidence.observation: MJ0056 has a riboflavin-kinase-like fold with bound CDP despite undetectable sequence similarity to known kinases. Its homologs are adjacent to ribB in multiple archaea. It also occurs in riboflavin auxotrophs, consistent with phosphorylation of salvaged vitamin rather than de novo riboflavin synthesis alone.
